title: Pīti
text: 1-6 Sāvatthi || || Addasā kho āyasmā Ānando || pe || vippasannāni kho te āvuso Sāriputta indriyāni parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto || katamenāyasmā Sāriputto ajja vihārena vihāsīti || || 7-8 Idhāham āvuso pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharāmi sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi [page 237] XXVIII. 7. 7-8] SĀRIPUTTA-SAṂYUTTA 237 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || so yeva peyyālo || ||
